title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Distribution of my wealth 1768 views Q. Distribution of asset of deceased 6495 views Q. I am in government service. My company deduct certain amount as income tax from my monthly salary. We are investing some amount in LIC,VPF etc for saving income tax, in which we get interest also. (VPF - Voluntary Provident Fund, after receiving salary we invest in it with our own company). In both the cases interest got credited to our accounts, which we normally gets after maturity. In VPF company credited interest to my account on monthly basis,while in LIC we got whole amount along with interest on maturity. My Questions: 1) Whether we can adjust interest due/received from LIC and VPF against the income tax deducted by the company? 2) Whether we can adjust income tax against interest received from any of the above source.(Either LIC or VPF) 3) Certain company allow its employees to deposit income tax at their own and produce a proof of deposit. In such a case, can I deposit the income tax of other person from the amount of Interest due to me and than taken back the same amount from him. Is it Ok? We have to pay huge amount as Income Tax, other persons are taking home loan on interest. Whatever a person repays loan interest to bank, government gives income tax benefits on it. In this situation can I take Home Loan and avoid income tax and pay Interest amount of the Loan from the Interest I am getting from my savings. 2404 views Q. I would be much obliged if you could pleased be kind to inform me under the Islamic Law what are the conditions for ORAL HIBBA, (2) can a person give the entire property by way of Oral hibba. (3) Some one is trying to claim the entire property after the death of the parents. 2668 views Q. June 19, 2009 Assalamualaikum Wo Rahmathullahi Barkathahu, My name is Mohammed Safiulla from Bangalore, India. Kindly let me know the Fatwa in light of Quran and Sunnah. My Father in law passed away last year. May Allah reward him with a place in Jannathul firdose. Amin. Summ Amin. My deceased Father in law has two sons-one married and the other a bachelor and one daughter who is also married. I would like to know how the property that used to be owned by my deceased father in law need to be distributed. My mother in law is alive and she is taking the family pension. Also let me know whether the children have any rights in the deceased?s pension also. Also my deceased father in law has got some ancestral property from his father. Kindly let me know whether the grand children (two grand sons and a grand daughter) have got any right in this property. Please note that there is no WILL on any of the properties by my deceased Father in law. Your earliest reply would be highly appreciated. 1676 views Q. Q-In the presence of a son, is it permissible for the daughter (who has money) to pay the debts of deseased Father?please provide reference. 1683 views Q. A expired in May 1962 leaving 8 sons and 2 daughters(one married).First 2 elder sons took the charge of two shops of father and brought up all the others brothers and sisters from the income of that two shops. Now in the year 2010 all brothers are established on there own with there own family.In 2008 the second brother-in-law on behalf of second sister demanded from the whole existing property and that also with present valuation of the property. Will he be geting as per shariah or from the present valuation of the two shops or from the whole property(as per present valuation) or from the property left in 1962 by father? 1466 views Q. Assalamualaikum Brother A friends mom want to write a will and give away all her wealth to a cancer charity in canada.The whole family is muslim. She has three daughters aged 22, 20 and 7. My question is that can the mother give away all her wealth in charity after she dies or even while she is alive? If the mother has permission of her two adult daughters, can she give it away then, minus the share of the little sister? Would it be okay for a muslim lady to give everything to a charity in canada instead of helping people here in pakistan where she normally resides? Is it okay for Muslims to give charity to christian or any other organisations besides muslims'? If the mother does write this will and give away everything to this cancer charity in canada without consulting with her daughters, would she be held accountable on the day of judgement, i mean is that a sin? Also please keep in mind that her husband is well off too and the mom generally has a tendency to help the needy, so please let me know whats the best possible option for her knowing that she has always wanted to help the poor and the needy. answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Inheritance & Will Question ID: 33110 Country: India Title: My father died some 4 years back and has left some property. Question: My father died some 4 years back and has left some property. Please let us know how to share father's property? He is survived by my one stepmother, 2 brothers one stepsister and 2 stepbrothers. Please advise the sharing percentage. Answer ID: 33110 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1108/934/B=1432) If both of you and stepbrothers and sisters are from the same father, then all the property of deceased shall be divided into 72 shares as per the Shariah. Your mother shall get 9 shares, 14-14 shares will be given to each son and 7 shares to the daughter. The detail of distribution is as follows: Detail: Wife: 1x09 = 09 Sons: 4x14 = 56 Daughter: 1x07 = 07 Total: 73 Shares Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
